name: @a2app/integration-pi
description: Agent App Framework plugin for Pi (earendil-works/pi): the /agent-app launcher command plus the six framework skills, driving the agent-app and a2app CLIs. Command + skills, no tool code — the same declarative shape as the Claude Code plugin.
//pi: A Pi package manifest (packages.md). `prompts` ships the /agent-app launcher; `skills` points at the single source of truth at the repo root (../../skills) so a git/local-path install finds them with no copy step. If your Pi rejects an out-of-root skills path, use the CLI instead — `agent-app skills --install ~/.pi/agent/skills` — which is Pi's native global skills dir. See README.

scripts.build: node -e "process.stdout.write('pi plugin: declarative pi-package (command + skills); no build step\n')"
scripts.typecheck: node -e "process.stdout.write('pi plugin: no code to typecheck (prompt template + skills)\n')"
